scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:server: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:server && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.install:server: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix server
